name: TelOne Harare Data Centre / Runhare House
notes: Official TelOne page: 'Tier 3 Data Centre Environment', data-centre/cloud/colocation/DRaaS/rack services, address Runhare House, 107 Kwame Nkrumah Avenue, Causeway, Harare (A). Techzim (B) reported March 2017 launch as first phase of the National Data Centre. 'Tier 3' is operator wording, not Uptime certification; no capacity published.

name: Econet Data Centre (EDC)
developer: Econet Wireless Zimbabwe (Africa Data Centres sister-company design/build)
notes: Press-reported 5 MW Harare data centre with corporate client onboarding from late June 2025 (Mbare Times, B); located in Willowvale per Zambian Observer coverage (B); 10 MW expansion reported planned for AI demand (B). Needs an Econet-owned page or official filing for A-grade confirmation.

name: Econet InfraCo airport industrial park + large-scale data centre
developer: Econet InfraCo (spun out of Econet Wireless Zimbabwe; VFEX-listed 2026)
notes: Planned/MoU-intent: 300 ha industrial park near Robert Mugabe International Airport with up to 100 MW solar and a large-scale data centre concept (The Zimbabwe Mail/NewZWire/Newsday, B). No ZIDA/ZERA/ZETDC/council/EMA permit or construction evidence found; not counted as a facility per methodology.

name: Liquid Intelligent Technologies Zimbabwe (data centre lead)
developer: Liquid Intelligent Technologies (Africa Data Centres group)
notes: Liquid Zimbabwe presence (Block B, Stand 45/47, Sam Levy Office Park, Piers Road, Borrowdale) confirmed for office/wholesale data, voice and IP services (A via methodology country page). A dedicated Liquid/ADC data centre in Harare is only directory-listed (datacentermap lists 2 Harare facilities; C). No official facility page with specs found; do not count as confirmed facility.

name: Dandemutande (Utande) existing colocation / public data cloud centre
notes: Dandemutande is a licensed IAP with a data centre/cloud/ICT portfolio (Console Connect ecosystem listing, B; operator media page A for company existence). The Zimbabwe Mail (B) reported launch of Zimbabwe's first public data cloud centre. Facility address/capacity not published on current operator pages; operational lead, needs current official colo page for A-grade.

name: Dandemutande US$15m Tier III carrier-neutral data centre
notes: DCD 2025-02 (B) and Structure & Design Zim (B) report a US$15m Tier III carrier-neutral data centre planned under ITU Partner2Connect with target live date June 2026. Location/specs not disclosed; completion not confirmed as of this review.

name: Government National Data Centre (OPC / eGP DATACENTR procurement)
developer: Government of Zimbabwe (Office of the President and Cabinet / Ministry of ICT)
notes: Ministry of ICT projects page treats National Data Centre as centralized data-infrastructure policy/project context (A). Techzim (B) ties TelOne's 2017 Harare launch to phase one; Bulawayo24 (B) reports Feb 2021 Presidential commissioning. eGP portal live (A surface); methodology-verified tender OPC/DATACENTR/D/10/2025 (Tender Id 42451, Munhumutapa Building, GoZ Treasury) is an A-grade procurement/government-facility lead for data-centre services. Exact facility identity/address/capacity not officially confirmed.

name: TelOne Bulawayo Data Centre
notes: Launched 29 Apr 2022. Techzim/DCD/Ecofin (B): 120 racks, 400 kVA total power capacity, 'Tier 3 Designed' facility, the only such facility in Bulawayo; ~US$4m invested since 2016 (Mobile Europe, B). kVA not converted to MW; address remains C-grade until TelOne/council confirms.

name: TelOne Mazowe Earth Station Data Centre
notes: Opened Mar 2022 as TelOne's fourth data centre at Mazowe Earth Station. Mapped to Mashonaland Central (not Harare) per methodology; directories misclassify it under Harare (C). DCD (B): 34 racks, 1,300 sqm; Newsday (B): US$1m expansion installed by Tendo Electronics.
